owned_invariants: Original bytes are restored after every mutant and on any exit.
boundaries: Mutates files in place in the directory it is given; run it in a copy to work in parallel.

score.level_basis: Mutation campaigns with honest six-outcome accounting for two languages (AST mutants for Python, lexical for C#), a recovery journal, a fresh bytecode cache per campaign, configurable exit-code semantics, and justified, hash-bound equivalents.

basis.G1: Header declares AuthorityEffect: None and a unique contract URN; the exported names (__all__ or public types) are the ones the docstring describes and the contract lists. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond this contract.
basis.G2: Non-Numeric profile: inputs are admitted by strict Pydantic models before use (RULE_PY_001) and outputs are typed; behaviour matches the documented contract in the module docstring and README. R is computed exactly as SCORING.md 3.4 defines it; timeouts are never kills; an empty campaign reports null.
basis.G3: Every expected failure is a typed exception with a stable code (AdmissionError, BudgetExceededError, UnknownPackError) or a typed verdict; no assert in production code (Ruff S101, AST test) and the whole suite passes under python -O; no bare or broad except (Ruff BLE001/E722). Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: Unit and boundary tests for every branch, negative tests for each refusal, run under pytest and under python -O. Every operator, outcome, the journal recovery path, the budget and both runners are tested on a throwaway project. Mutation R = 154/157 (see mutation_accounting).
basis.G5: Functions are single-purpose; complexity measured per function. Metrics: worst function: cyclomatic 12, cognitive 13, nesting 3; metrics ceiling B.
